turn_and_generation_accounting.one_visible_generation: One distinct assistant message ID. Thinking/output chunks with that same ID are stream fragments. A distinct second ID is another visible model generation, even if called formatting or continuation. Strict Path A still requires prevention; proposed Path B permits only the bounded continuation described below.
turn_and_generation_accounting.formatting: A local tool result can add a CLI turn without another model generation. A new model call to format or fix schema is an additional generation and is forbidden. Output-limit continuation is a separate, explicitly bounded Path B proposal, never free local formatting.
turn_and_generation_accounting.internal_retries: Separate HTTP/network retries, output-limit recovery and schema reprompting. MAX_RETRIES=0 controls failed API request retries; it does not certify absence of the other loops.
turn_and_generation_accounting.observability: Record CLI invocations, distinct assistant IDs, distinct visible request IDs, synthetic continuation notices, formatting calls, failed tool results, terminal subtype, reported agentic turns and UNKNOWN total underlying provider request count separately. Never publish private IDs or transcript content in the public report.
turn_and_generation_accounting.recommended_exploratory_bound: At most two visible model generations within one parent CLI invocation: initial generation plus at most one clearly evidenced, append-only output-limit continuation. No separate parent continuation call, complete-answer replacement, schema/semantic repair, best-of or optional refinement. Unknown continuation provenance, a third generation or extra unexplained request IDs are deviations and stop further dispatch. This is a post-hoc compliance rule, not a provider-request prevention guarantee.

budget_proposal.aggregate_formula: ordinary input + cache-creation input + cache-read input + output, across all activity reported for the attempt, including continuation and failed work; count each reported total once
budget_proposal.boundary: Propose an inclusive 60000-token accounting threshold for every condition, without a hidden tolerance. No separate scientific input or output ceiling, and no transfers between attempts.
budget_proposal.output_planning_role: Nonbinding planning guidance for total output across the attempt, not a generation target, minimum, separate output cap or reserved split. Output above this guide can comply when combined reported consumption is at most 60000.
budget_proposal.runtime_output_setting: The complete package must freeze one common supported per-response output setting and continuation configuration. Do not inherit the V003 setting or turn the planning guide into a scientific output cap. No new runtime setting is activated by this proposal.
budget_proposal.thinking_tokens: Preserve available detail; do not add a thinking subcount to output_tokens again.
budget_proposal.cached_inputs: Count ordinary + cache-creation + cache-read from terminal totals, once. No per-chunk summation or cache discount.
budget_proposal.unchanged_other_caps: Retain V003's common generation wall/human/review limits unless separately amended prospectively.
budget_proposal.caps_not_certified: CLI per-request max output and max agentic turns do not certify the combined invocation allowance. Strict Path A must reject dispatch without a defensible complete-input/output/request-count prevention proof. Proposed Path B explicitly treats the combined allowance as post-hoc compliance and discloses possible excess; estimates are never certificates.
budget_proposal.cap_or_usage_failure: Retain every simultaneous deviation. Combined usage above 60000 or missing/conflicting required usage stops later dispatch under Path B. Preserve all actual consumption; never repair accounting or reclassify a V003 failure using this later allowance.
budget_proposal.billing: Token consumption and subscription billing are separate. Preserve reported usage and CLI list-price estimates with their labels. Actual per-attempt subscription charges/currency remain UNKNOWN unless independently observable and attributable; do not infer zero charges, prorate subscription fees, or enable billable APIs/overage.

prospective_payload_changes: Send the response schema once as prompt data; remove the additional CLI tool-schema transport.

Consider a minimal payload projection retaining exact condition instructions, eligible evidence/memory content and cutoff while removing transport/audit duplication. Document and hash the projection; do not edit or reuse V003 requests as V004 requests.

Do not impose the fictional under-18-word directive or compress substantive reasoning to meet an obsolete output cap. Preserve detailed mechanisms, qualifications, evidence, joins and falsifiers. No reduction of the full response schema.
Any evidence/memory reduction to establish an input bound changes the scientific inputs, requires a new prospective package and consent, and cannot be reported as an unchanged V003 replication.
failure_classification: Structured terminal subtype first. Auth/rate classification uses designated API status or structured error type, with a narrowly anchored stderr-only fallback before an envelope. Never search full stdout for auth/login/401/429. Preserve independent model, environment, generation, schema and budget faults.
environment: Retain separate research configuration, child-only allowlisted environment, explicit binary/hash/version, safe/restricted modes, empty settings/MCP/tools, disabled skills/Chrome/persistence, fresh UUID and sterile directory. Separate environment isolation from generation independence; neither is an OS sandbox.
scientific_controls: Freeze all 12 new requests/runtime/implementation before dispatch; preserve identical eligible pools/allocation unless a documented amendment is essential. Same 60000 combined allowance, output planning guide and visible-generation/continuation rules for all four conditions. No previous-attempt generated cards in any context; an approved append-only continuation can see only its own unfinished attempt. No application retries, replacements, best-of or schema/semantic repairs. Every invalid/missing/surplus output remains represented in human review. Report actual input components, output/thinking details, combined totals, visible generations, deviations, unknowns and effort by attempt and condition; equal allowances do not establish equal actual consumption. Partial procedural blinding and independent human judgment remain required.
combined_budget_fairness_tradeoff: The existing lane-specific access to a common eligible pool intentionally produces different input sizes. Under a combined allowance, a smaller input leaves more potential output/continuation headroom. Disclose this as a workflow-design tradeoff, retain common limits/rules and report actual consumption; do not add condition-specific top-ups, change pools or equalise output afterwards.
